title: Understanding is not acting
hook: A clear pattern is not an instruction to act.
body_or_script: Understanding what you noticed is one step. Choosing what to do with it is another. The reading helps you name the pattern; the decision is yours.
caption: Name it. Then choose.
asset_note: Do not push immediate action or chase framing.
notes: Manual publish only after Day011 checklist is clear.

title: Understanding and deciding
hook: Understanding and deciding are two different steps.
body_or_script: You can see the pattern and still choose to wait. A useful reading hands the choice back; it does not pick the action for you.
caption: Two steps, not one.
notes: Manual publish only after Day011 checklist is clear.

title: See the pattern wait
hook: You can see the pattern and still choose to wait.
body_or_script: Reflection is allowed to be quiet. The reading surfaces the pattern; the next step is yours to time, not the algorithm's.
caption: Reflect first.
notes: Manual publish only after Day011 checklist is clear.

title: Three questions before acting
hook: Three questions before you act on what you noticed.
body_or_script: Carousel: 1) What did I actually notice. 2) What am I about to do with it. 3) Is that mine to do right now.
caption: Save and reflect.
notes: Manual publish only after Day011 checklist is clear.

title: Decide or be told
hook: A reading that tells you what to do is shorter than one that helps you decide.
body_or_script: Trust note: the shorter the instruction, the less it is doing for you. The longer the question, the more it is leaving with you.
caption: Decide, not be told.
notes: Manual publish only after Day011 checklist is clear.
